shared_elements: standing human figure in profile, low relief
stylized tree/plant with rows of leaves or fronds
figure adjacent to/alternating with a tree motif
long garment with patterned fringe or detailing
justification: Both depict robed human figures shown in strict profile in shallow relief, set beside vertical stylized trees whose leaves are rendered as regular repeated fronds, with the figure-and-tree alternation organized into horizontal registers — a fairly specific shared convention rather than a generic one. The clearest difference in content is that A shows a single large winged figure with a raised hand and bucket-like attribute filling one panel, while B shows repeated unwinged figures in file along a stepped facade with no wings or attributes clearly comparable.
